concerns.text: FR-006 and US-1 Scenario 2 require an independent test set (polynomial surfaces) for generalization validation. Task T008c (generate_polynomial_test_data) is marked incomplete [ ]. Without this data generation task, the baseline validation (T014) and the entire US-1 acceptance criteria cannot be satisfied.

FR-006 and US-1 Scenario 2 require validating generalization on the independent test set. Task T014 (validate_generalization) is marked incomplete [ ]. This task is the direct implementation of the acceptance scenario and is missing from the executable plan.

SC-002 requires measuring training stability via gradient norm distribution. Task T010b (log_gradient_norms) is marked incomplete [ ] in the provided text (despite the 'X' checkbox, the description implies it was 'REJECTED' or missing in the analyze report context, and the task list shows it as a prerequisite for T011b). If T010b is not implemented, SC-002 verification is impossible.

FR-001, FR-003, and US-3 define the scope as a single canonical microcircuit and specific ablations (recurrence, inhibition). Tasks T090-T094 (Rule Space Enumeration) introduce a massive scope expansion (searching 10-20 topological variants) not present in the Spec or Plan. These tasks have no matching FR/SC and risk violating FR-004 (6-hour CPU limit) by adding unverified work.

Tasks T090-T094 reference 'Reviewer Response - Computational Irreducibility' and 'Stephen Wolfram' as the source. These personas/concerns do not exist in the provided spec.md or plan.md. These are stale tags from an external or hypothetical conversation, creating a disconnect between the task list and the official specification.
